name: kryptonite
description: A coding agent for endpoints that don't behave. mTLS, corporate CAs, token exchange, air-gapped.

kryptonite.activeProfile.description: Name of the active endpoint profile. First valid profile is used when empty.

kryptonite.approvalMode.description: When tools run without confirming: ask = every side effect; edits-auto = file edits auto, shell commands ask; full-auto = never ask.

kryptonite.caBundlePath.description: Global fallback CA bundle merged into every profile's tls.caBundle at load time. Accepts a file path or the literal 'system'.

scripts.test:bundle: esbuild test/activation.ts test/send-path.ts test/skill-bounds.ts test/text-tool-protocol.ts test/tools.ts test/mcp-transport.ts test/image-endpoint.ts test/mcp-live.ts test/capabilities.ts test/browser.ts test/cdp.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node20 --alias:vscode=./test/vscode-stub.ts
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run test:bundle
scripts.test: node test/contrast.cjs && node test/markdown-render.cjs && node test/mcp-render.cjs && node test/browser-ui.cjs && node test/drive.js && node test/host.js && node dist/activation.cjs && node dist/send-path.cjs && node dist/skill-bounds.cjs && node dist/text-tool-protocol.cjs && node dist/tools.cjs && node dist/mcp-transport.cjs && node dist/image-endpoint.cjs && node dist/mcp-live.cjs && node dist/capabilities.cjs && node dist/browser.cjs && node dist/cdp.cjs
scripts.test:live: esbuild test/attachment-e2e.ts test/skill-gating-live.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node20 && node dist/attachment-e2e.cjs && node dist/skill-gating-live.cjs
scripts.test:mcp: npm install --no-save @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem && esbuild test/mcp-e2e.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node20 && node dist/mcp-e2e.cjs
